7. The decisive experiment

The first physical experiment should try to falsify the guide/load-path and whole-service claims, rather than proceed directly to an expensive endurance demonstration.

Initial gate

Build two full-size working cassettes and independently manufactured receiver lots. Use 20–30 complete cycles to establish:

Collision-free extension, rotation, draw and retraction.
Actual guide and receiver clearance separately.
Load-path stiffness and finite-bearing deformation.
Observable seating and positive retention.
Supported release force.
Common-meter electrical energy.
Actual temperatures and reset time.
Complete occupied robot time.

If the mechanism cannot establish the displacement limit or its manufactured service cost, do not proceed by inserting an ideal guide into the model.
